name: Vault Run — Sandbox

values.description: RGS REST base URL (no trailing slash). The hosted operator-mode sandbox is live at https://sandbox.vaultrun.app (integration testing only — not under the production SLA); point this at it once we confirm your access. See api-integration-spec.md §14.
RGS WebSocket (Socket.IO) base URL. Used for the WS handshake auth.token. See api-integration-spec.md §6 and the collection guide.
Your operator UUID (our tenant key). Goes into the launch-token `operatorId` claim and is the prefix of your reportingKey. Issued at onboarding. See spec §3.
Your 32-byte hex HMAC secret. The launch-JWT pre-request script signs the token with this (HMAC-SHA256). Issued once at onboarding; store in your secret manager. See spec §3/§4.
ISO-4217 currency for the launch (must be in your allow-list, case-insensitive). See spec §4/§8.
Your player/account id. Becomes the launch-token `playerId` claim and the wallet `playerId`. See spec §4/§7.
The signed launch JWT. Filled automatically by the pre-request script on `POST /api/operator/launch`, or paste one you minted server-side. Single-use (jti), 120 s TTL. See spec §4.

The session (play) token from the launch response. Auto-filled by the launch request's test script. Used as `Authorization: Bearer` for player routes and as the Socket.IO handshake auth.token. Default TTL 4 h. See spec §5/§6.
Reporting API key `vrk_<operatorId>.<secret>`. Sent as `Authorization: Bearer` against /api/operator/reports/*. Hard-scoped to your operatorId. Issued once. See spec §13.1.
YOUR seamless-wallet base URL (the endpoint the RGS calls). Folder 5 fires example /bet /win /rollback /balance requests at THIS to confirm your wallet speaks our protocol. See spec §7.
The Bearer key the RGS sends on every wallet call (the key YOU configured at onboarding). Folder 5 uses it to authenticate against your own wallet. See spec §3/§7.
Example RGS round id, used to build the wallet transactionId in folder 5 (`bet:{roundId}:{userId}:{panel}:debit`). In production the RGS supplies this on each /bet. See spec §7/§9.
Example RGS internal user id, used to build the stake transactionId in folder 5. (The RGS user is keyed `op:{operatorId}:{playerId}:{currency}` internally.) See spec §7/§9.
Example RGS bet id. Used to build the payout transactionId (`bet:{betId}:payout`) in folder 5 and as the reconciliation key for your operator book. See spec §7/§10.
A finished round id for GET /api/fairness/round/:id. Grab one from GET /api/rounds/history (its `id`). See spec §13.6 (round history: §13.5).
A fairness epoch number for GET /api/fairness/epoch/:epoch/seeds. List epochs via GET /api/fairness/epochs. See spec §13.6.
